rationale.consistency: Adheres to Go formatting and idioms, though using string(byte) instead of string([]byte{b}) is a common anti-pattern.
rationale.edge_cases: Fails on non-ASCII characters due to string(byte) rune conversion and makes the entire comparison incorrectly case-insensitive.
rationale.scope: Removes the reverse workaround and implements the suffix logic, but broadens case-insensitivity beyond the hex digits.
rationale.readability: The algorithm is well-structured and clearly commented, making the backward iteration logic straightforward to follow.
rationale.robustness: Safely bounds checks before indexing and gracefully handles unescape errors by leaving the path untouched.
rationale.maintainability: Iterating backward byte-by-byte is fragile for UTF-8 and makes future adjustments harder compared to a token-based approach.
